en_title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Launch Rollout Adds DMZ Early Access
cn_title: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》DMZ抢先体验
subtitle: 撤离战场再出发
opus_summary: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》预购玩家可于10月16日抢先体验战役，20日体验DMZ，标准版与宝库版均适用。游戏于23日正式发售，核心多人模式也将于当天上线。

paragraphs.en: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has added DMZ to its list of early access experiences available for pre-order players ahead of its launch later this month.
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》将于本月晚些时候发售，预购玩家可提前体验的内容现已新增DMZ模式。

paragraphs.en: Activision and Infinity Ward revealed a host of new details for its DMZ revamp in a blog post shared today. Early access for the mode joins campaign early access , with both available to those who pre-ordered either the standard or Vault Edition versions of the game across PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and/or Xbox Series X/S.
paragraphs.cn: Activision与Infinity Ward今天发布博客，公布了DMZ模式改版的诸多新细节。除了战役，玩家现在也能抢先体验DMZ模式。在PC、Switch 2、PS5或XBOX Series上预购标准版或宝库版的玩家，均可抢先体验这两部分内容。

paragraphs.en: Here's the full breakdown: Eligible players will gain early access to the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign starting Friday, October 16. DMZ early access will then follow Tuesday, October 20, with the full launch unleashing the rest of the experience come Friday, October 23. All of the new details arrived with a new gameplay trailer for DMZ, which you can see below.
paragraphs.cn: 具体安排如下：符合条件的玩家可从10月16日（周五）起抢先体验《使命召唤：现代战争4》的战役。DMZ模式将于10月20日（周二）开放抢先体验，其余内容则随游戏于10月23日（周五）正式上线。这些新细节与一支DMZ实机预告片一同公布，预告片可在下方观看。

paragraphs.en: DMZ was first introduced as Call of Duty's take on the extraction shooter experience with 2022's Modern Warfare 2 . It was expanded upon in the months that followed but was ultimately deemed to be an underwhelming prototype by many. Support ended in late 2023, and now, Activision is taking another swing at it.
paragraphs.cn: DMZ最早随2022年的《使命召唤：现代战争2》推出，是《使命召唤》对撤离射击玩法的尝试。此后数月，这一模式不断扩充，但最终仍有许多人觉得它只是个令人失望的原型。该模式于2023年末停止支持，如今Activision准备再试一次。

paragraphs.en: The DMZ in Modern Warfare 4 has been propped up as a fully fleshed-out evolution for the game mode. In today's post, Infinity Ward described the new take on the mode as the series' "definitive extraction shooter experience," promising persistent progression in the open-world combat environment known as the Hajin Exclusion Zone.
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》中的DMZ被宣传为这一模式全面完善后的进化版本。在今天的博文中，Infinity Ward将新版DMZ称为系列的「终极撤离射击体验」，并承诺玩家将在名为Hajin Exclusion Zone的开放世界战场中持续积累进度。

paragraphs.en: "There's an interesting story with the DMZ beta, where we had to make some decisions," studio multiplayer creative director Joe Cecot said in a recent behind-the-scenes video (below). "Certain things we wanted to do, we couldn't do. At the end of the day, we learned a lot: That we made a very approachable, fun sandbox that was fun to fight in, to explore, to make friends in, to get into fights in. There's a bunch of stuff we left on the table, so as soon as we finished with the last game, we were just gung-ho on, 'OK, we know what we want to do.'"
paragraphs.cn: 工作室多人模式创意总监Joe Cecot在最近的一段幕后视频（见下方）中表示：「DMZ测试版背后有段有趣的故事，当时我们不得不做一些决定。有些我们想做的东西，没能做成。到最后，我们学到了很多：我们做出了一个很容易上手、很有趣的沙盒，在里面战斗、探索、交朋友、与人交火都很有意思。还有很多东西我们没能实现，所以一完成上一款游戏，我们就满怀干劲：好了，我们知道自己想做什么了。」

paragraphs.en: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches October 23 for PC and consoles. Our first proper look at DMZ gameplay arrived in June, with even more details shared earlier this week. While early access players will get to dive into DMZ and the story mode a few days earlier than others, core multiplayer offerings won't officially launch until that firm release date hits. You can see how the team at Infinity Ward is working to deal with wall-hack cheaters here .
paragraphs.cn: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》将于10月23日登陆PC和主机。我们在6月首次详细看到了DMZ的实机玩法，本周早些时候又有更多细节公布。获得抢先体验资格的玩家虽然能比其他人早几天进入DMZ和剧情模式，但核心多人模式仍要等到正式发售日才会上线。Infinity Ward团队也在着手应对使用透视外挂的作弊者。
